title: Zorii Bliss
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: Kijimi Spice Runner Zorii Bliss, was a friend of Poe Dameron during their youth. That friendship soured when Poe left Kijimi behind to join the Resistance against the First Order. Zorii still helped Poe, taking him to Babu Frik. Zorii and Frik were thought dead when the First Order destroyed Kijimi. They survived and fought in the Battle of Exegol.
